summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would establish the Australian Cannabis Agency and a licensing system for producing and distributing recreational cannabis in the Australian Capital Territory and Northern Territory.
Licensed distribution would be restricted to adults, require plain packaging and warnings, and involve staff trained in mental health first aid and responsible cannabis distribution.
Medicinal cannabis arrangements would remain unchanged, and the main scheme would commence when funding for the agency is appropriated rather than automatically on Royal Assent.
changes: The agency would set a wholesale buying and selling price during an initial two-year period.
Unlicensed production involving seven or more plants would attract criminal and civil penalties.
People with six or fewer plants could give their cannabis to other individuals without payment.
summary.affected: Recreational cannabis producers, distributors and consumers in the two territories, and the new agency, are affected.
